Recorder, the recorder, source recorded

Note: A HEAD that is not a descendant of the base commit makes the snapshot unobservable and voids a bound task. The notice flag is set only at the Stop that closes a segment, for a payload without turn_id. The recorder imports components, extract, and transcript inside the functions that use them.
g.title: Note: A HEAD that is not a descendant of the base commit makes the snapshot unobservable and voids a bound task. The notice flag is set only at the Stop that closes a segment, for a payload without turn_id. The recorder imports components, extract, and transcript inside the functions that use them.

g.aria-label: WorkingTree, the repository checkout, outside
Ledger, the ledger, source recorded

Note: Each table in schema.CLAIMS has a CHECK that fixes its one claim class and refuses an empty source list. The attributions table accepts any claim class, and hook_events has none. Triggers make the measurement tables append-only, and a task or a map sets each transition column once. segment_close writes the outcomes and the task close in one transaction. The survival lookup intersects agent line-hash multisets with a probe multiset, so two identical lines count as two. When PRAGMA user_version differs from SCHEMA_VERSION, Store.open runs the DDL and then migrate.
g.title: Note: Each table in schema.CLAIMS has a CHECK that fixes its one claim class and refuses an empty source list. The attributions table accepts any claim class, and hook_events has none. Triggers make the measurement tables append-only, and a task or a map sets each transition column once. segment_close writes the outcomes and the task close in one transaction. The survival lookup intersects agent line-hash multisets with a probe multiset, so two identical lines count as two. When PRAGMA user_version differs from SCHEMA_VERSION, Store.open runs the DDL and then migrate.

g.aria-label: ItemPool, the item pool, source recorded
Note: A change to a frozen map needs a --reason from MAP_REASONS. A second freeze writes only the missing pairs. A component without a parsed Python file gives no items, not items with truth 0.
g.title: Note: A change to a frozen map needs a --reason from MAP_REASONS. A second freeze writes only the missing pairs. A component without a parsed Python file gives no items, not items with truth 0.

Note: The command surface, the doctor, the item pool, the task registration, and the probe call locate. The doctor and the probe call attached_agents.
g.title: Note: The command surface, the doctor, the item pool, the task registration, and the probe call locate. The doctor and the probe call attached_agents.

Extractors, the extractors, source recorded
Note: The recorder, the item pool, the task registration, and the probe call static_imports. No praxis module calls run_scenario or scratch_clone yet.
g.title: Note: The recorder, the item pool, the task registration, and the probe call static_imports. No praxis module calls run_scenario or scratch_clone yet.

g.aria-label: TaskRegistration, the task registration, source recorded

Note: The arm generator reads only the seed, the repository id, and the task ordinal. The recorder, not this module, binds the task to the next prompt and closes its segment. praxis last calls last, which prints only the feedback.
g.title: Note: The arm generator reads only the seed, the repository id, and the task ordinal. The recorder, not this module, binds the task to the next prompt and closes its segment. praxis last calls last, which prints only the feedback.

Probe, the unassisted probe, source recorded

Note: A structural item without a truth from the extractors now is not asked and stays due. The knockout is simulated from stored scenario runs. Pathfinder ratings stay in memory and only the scores are stored.
g.title: Note: A structural item without a truth from the extractors now is not asked and stays due. The knockout is simulated from stored scenario runs. Pathfinder ratings stay in memory and only the scores are stored.

g.aria-label: ComponentMap, the component map, source recorded
Note: The ledger calls from_json before it stores a map. The recorder, the item pool, the task registration, the probe, and the report parse the frozen map and assign paths with it.
g.title: Note: The ledger calls from_json before it stores a map. The recorder, the item pool, the task registration, the probe, and the report parse the frozen map and assign paths with it.

Note: The probe and the report call locate and read, and the recorder calls options_hash. The name sets that it returns must never be stored.

g.aria-label: PraxisHome, the praxis home directory, outside
Doctor, the read-only doctor, source recorded
Note: Counts come from a SQLite read-only connection. Probes due come from probe.due, which opens a Store. The doctor asks for them only at SCHEMA_VERSION, so no migration can run.

g.aria-label: Report, the report, source recorded
Note: render refuses the words cause, impact, and would unless a pre-registered rule is met, and then it names the rule. A reference that cannot be fitted is NULL, never another reference.
g.title: Note: render refuses the words cause, impact, and would unless a pre-registered rule is met, and then it names the rule. A reference that cannot be fitted is NULL, never another reference.

g.aria-label: Scoring, the scoring functions, source recorded
Note: No I/O and no imports from other praxis modules. The probe calls pfnet and pfsim. The report calls bss, decomposition, corp_reliability, randomization_test, and snap.
g.title: Note: No I/O and no imports from other praxis modules. The probe calls pfnet and pfsim. The report calls bss, decomposition, corp_reliability, randomization_test, and snap.
